title: AiMePreferencesV1
description: ai.me-preferences@1 (OpenVibe.AI; L36 Y1/Y3): how one person's AI runs route, stored per person under GET/PUT /api/v1/me/ai/preferences. `only_my_keys` means exactly that: a failed or missing key is never quietly replaced by a paid route. `free_first` puts free tiers ahead of paid ones. `price_ceiling_usd_per_mtok` caps the network's paid fallback per million tokens; the person's own keys are never capped. Each default is a model id or `auto`.

modelChoice.description: A model id, or `auto` to let placement choose.
